label: D28-hapus-kartu-tanpa-kunci
decision: How should the app handle deleting a card whose credential private key is missing, when a proof of possession is impossible?

candidates.description: Skip the server step and delete the record and card locally; ask for authentication when the device can authenticate, allow deletion without it when no passcode is set; tell the user honestly what remains on the server.
Do not allow deletion without the key; direct the user to device transfer (FR-41).
Local deletion but always require authentication; blocked when no passcode is set.

priorities: 1) A user can always remove a card that can no longer be used. 2) No access is granted or kept. 3) Respect FR-31 authentication wherever possible. 4) Be honest about the server.
requirements: A card whose key is gone can always be removed from the app, even when the device has no passcode.
Deleting such a card grants or keeps no access path.
When the device can authenticate, deletion still asks for authentication.
